title: 客户留存与同期群分析
learningObjective: 能够识别首购月份、构造观察期、按客户去重计算留存率及次月留存。
concept: 同期群是按共同起点划分的一组客户，本题起点为历史首购月份。第0月为首购月；第1月为下一自然月，不是首购后30天。每期留存率=该同期群当月购买的去重客户数÷首购群原始人数。各月分别计算，因此不要求连续活跃，客户中途不买后再次购买仍可计入当月留存。
syntax: WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)) cohort FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT cohort,COUNT(*) n FROM a GROUP BY cohort), m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), x AS (SELECT b.cohort,m.month_key,b.n,(CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,1,4) AS SIGNED)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,1,4) AS SIGNED))*12+CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,6,2) AS SIGNED)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,6,2) AS SIGNED) k FROM b CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.month_key>=b.cohort), y AS (SELECT a.cohort,SUBSTR(o.order_date,1,7) m,COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) active FROM a JOIN v_order_net o ON o.customer_id=a.customer_id AND o.channel='online' GROUP BY a.cohort,SUBSTR(o.order_date,1,7)) SELECT x.cohort,x.k month_offset,x.n cohort_size,COALESCE(y.active,0) active_customers,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(y.active,0)/x.n,2) retention_pct FROM x LEFT JOIN y ON y.cohort=x.cohort AND y.m=x.month_key WHERE x.k BETWEEN 0 AND 6 ORDER BY x.cohort,x.k

parameters.金额: 整数马币分；比率按题设

executionSteps: 去重统计每月活跃客户
useCase: 线上有效订单，历史首购月份确定同期群；观察截止2025-12-31，月偏移0至6。一同期群×月偏移一行。已观察而无购买记0，未来未观察月份不展示；分母沿用同期群初始人数。
comparison: 次月留存是特定同期群的偏移1，与年度复购率不同；月活跃人数不是订单数。

commonError.example: 把分母换成上月活跃人数，或把未来月份填零。
commonError.correction: 始终保留首购群规模；使用截至观察日的月份轴；按客户去重。

notes: 完整输出见 ../enterprise_reference/business_tasks/results/BP13.json；公开预览展示前12行。独立边界及场景仅在提交判题时使用。

teaching.problem: 线上有效订单，历史首购月份确定同期群；观察截止2025-12-31，月偏移0至6。一同期群×月偏移一行。已观察而无购买记0，未来未观察月份不展示；分母沿用同期群初始人数。
teaching.codeExplanation: a 用 MIN 得首购月份，b 按同期群数客户；m 从日历抽取完整月份；x 将同期群与月份交叉连接，仅保留不早于首购且不晚于截止月的组合，月偏移=年份差×12+月份差。y 将订单连接首购群，再按群和月去重客户。最终用 x 左连接 y，缺交易且已观察的月份填0。原生数据库转换整数用 SIGNED，本地示例用 INTEGER。
teaching.resultExplanation: 9月首购群2人，10月客户1有两笔订单但只算1人，次月留存50%；11月0%，12月客户1回来为50%，说明本口径不是连续留存。12月群在样例中只有第0月，不能填未来月份0%。原企业2023年1月群7人，次月4人留存57.14%，第三个观察月2人28.57%；不同群应比较相同偏移并确认观察窗口。

checkpoints.name: a
checkpoints.label: 确定客户首购月份
checkpoints.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)) cohort FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' GROUP BY customer_id)
SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 3;

checkpoints.name: b
checkpoints.label: 统计同期群初始人数
checkpoints.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)) cohort FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT cohort,COUNT(*) n FROM a GROUP BY cohort)
SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 3;

checkpoints.name: m
checkpoints.label: 建立日期维度月份
checkpoints.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)) cohort FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT cohort,COUNT(*) n FROM a GROUP BY cohort), m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31')
SELECT * FROM m ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 3;

checkpoints.name: x
checkpoints.label: 生成同期群观察月份及月偏移
checkpoints.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)) cohort FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT cohort,COUNT(*) n FROM a GROUP BY cohort), m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), x AS (SELECT b.cohort,m.month_key,b.n,(CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,1,4) AS INTEGER)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,1,4) AS INTEGER))*12+CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,6,2) AS INTEGER)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,6,2) AS INTEGER) k FROM b CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.month_key>=b.cohort)
SELECT * FROM x ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4 LIMIT 3;

checkpoints.name: y
checkpoints.label: 统计各期活跃客户
checkpoints.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)) cohort FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT cohort,COUNT(*) n FROM a GROUP BY cohort), m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), x AS (SELECT b.cohort,m.month_key,b.n,(CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,1,4) AS INTEGER)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,1,4) AS INTEGER))*12+CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,6,2) AS INTEGER)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,6,2) AS INTEGER) k FROM b CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.month_key>=b.cohort), y AS (SELECT a.cohort,SUBSTR(o.order_date,1,7) m,COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) active FROM a JOIN v_order_net o ON o.customer_id=a.customer_id AND o.channel='online' GROUP BY a.cohort,SUBSTR(o.order_date,1,7))
SELECT * FROM y ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 LIMIT 3;

mergedConcepts.explanation: 次月留存取偏移1，分母为首购月群规模；同客户次月多单仍只计一人。

mergeExamples.label: 首购月份与群规模
mergeExamples.explanation: 客户1、2首购在9月，客户3在10月，客户4在12月。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_order_net(customer_id,order_date,channel) AS (
 SELECT 1,'2025-09-01','online' UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-10-01','online' UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-10-05','online' UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-12-01','online' UNION ALL
 SELECT 2,'2025-09-02','online' UNION ALL SELECT 3,'2025-10-03','online' UNION ALL SELECT 3,'2025-12-02','online' UNION ALL SELECT 4,'2025-12-03','online'
), calendar_days(day,month_key) AS (SELECT '2025-09-01','2025-09' UNION ALL SELECT '2025-10-01','2025-10' UNION ALL SELECT '2025-11-01','2025-11' UNION ALL SELECT '2025-12-01','2025-12'),
a AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)) cohort FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' GROUP BY customer_id),
b AS (SELECT cohort,COUNT(*) n FROM a GROUP BY cohort),
m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'),
x AS (SELECT b.cohort,m.month_key,b.n,(CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,1,4) AS INTEGER)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,1,4) AS INTEGER))*12+CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,6,2) AS INTEGER)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,6,2) AS INTEGER) k FROM b CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.month_key>=b.cohort),
y AS (SELECT a.cohort,SUBSTR(o.order_date,1,7) m,COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) active FROM a JOIN v_order_net o ON o.customer_id=a.customer_id AND o.channel='online' GROUP BY a.cohort,SUBSTR(o.order_date,1,7))
SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY cohort
